title: A crisis that transformed the region
goal: Sum up the changes of the 1930s, with argument markers such as *por un lado ... por otro lado* and *en resumen*.

items: I can build and close an explanation, with *por un lado ... por otro lado* and *en resumen*.
I can say what happened in Argentina and Brazil in 1930.
I can explain how the crisis changed the role of the State and the economy.
I can use the words *el golpe militar*, *el papel*, *la confianza* and *el líder*.
